name: Swim Meet
source:
Rei has been struggling to find new friends and so has decided to start a swimming club in order to train for competitions once more… But will her plan to meet friends and win the upcoming swim meet be successful… You decide.

[From [url=https://dharkerstudios.com/swim-meet/]website[/url]]
translation:
Rei一直在努力寻找新朋友，因此决定成立一家游泳俱乐部，以便再次训练比赛……但她与朋友见面并赢得即将举行的游泳比赛的计划能否成功……由你决定。

[来自[url=https://dharkerstudios.com/swim-meet/]网站[/url]]
